Read a raster shipped with the package

ae_raster.Rd

Read a raster shipped with the package

Usage

ae_raster(layer = c("aedes", "dengue", "risk"))

Arguments

layer

One of "aedes" (probability of Aedes aegypti occurrence), "dengue" (probability of confirmed imported dengue cases) or "risk" (five-level epidemiological risk).

Value

A terra::SpatRaster of about 500 m. "aedes" and "dengue" hold the probability (0-1), the mean of the Random Forest, LightGBM and XGBoost models. "risk" has two layers: cluster (k-means cluster) and risk (the five-level epidemiological risk).

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
terra::plot(ae_raster("aedes"))
} # }
